referenceProvenance.identity: The exact OG Yunichick: a slim upright bird-pony hybrid with huge warm red-brown eyes, a short pointed blue beak and blue eye masks, a layered teal/coral feather crown, long slender legs with blue hoof-like toes, small folded side wings with red/blue feathers, fine curved feather markings on the body and a long curled tail with a feather tip. Preserve these distinctive features and OG stance; do not turn it into a round generic chicken.

prompts.palette:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image #1 is the EDIT TARGET: the exact Red Yunichick YUNIPALS card.
Image #2 is the ACTUAL OG Red Yunichick, the authority for the COMPLETE SPECIES-SPECIFIC COLORWAY, including secondary details and eyes.
Output one 1024 x 1536 PNG, portrait 2:3, with genuine transparent exterior.

Correct the ENTIRE MONSTER COLORWAY in image #1 to match the actual same-species, same-color OG in image #2. Apply its exact corresponding colors to body, hair/mane/feathers, shell, fins, feet, eye/iris, markings and accessories. Do not keep secondary colors from the old blue character. Image #1 controls geometry and design; image #2 controls ALL character colors except the explicitly requested horn trait.
OG PALETTE: OG red Unichick: soft salmon/coral skin with pale peach-pink highlights; mint-green irises and mint-green body markings; layered coral/pink forehead feathers with mint-green rear crown accents; red beak, red eye-mask/wing feather outlines, red feet and red tail-tip feathers with green inner wing feathers. No blue beak, blue eye masks, blue feathers or blue feet. Match the actual red OG colorway; the requested diamond horn overrides its original gold spiral horn.
Match the original OG hue, restrained saturation, lightness and warm/cool relationships between lit surfaces, midtones and shadows. Do not interpret the word Red as a generic vivid paint. The OG image is the color authority. Do not exaggerate saturation or make the body neon. Preserve crisp clean dimensional surfaces, readable form shading and sharp eye/face detail. Do not add grain, frost, blur, a cloudy glitter blanket or an outline glow.

STRICT INVARIANTS: preserve image #1's EXACT species identity, pose, silhouette, camera, crop, proportions, facial geometry, eye shapes, marking shapes, accessory shapes, fins/mane/feathers/wings shapes, Diamond horn, meadow, sky, windmill, all existing background star positions and rainbow streaks, official flat pink logo, lavender border, purple lettering, exact YUNIPALS header and exact YUNICHICK footer. No anatomy or composition changes. The old hair, eye and marking COLORS are intentionally NOT invariant: replace them with their corresponding colors from image #2. Preserve their shapes. Keep image #1's requested horn trait, stance and scene; do not replace the monster or change anatomy.
Keep this a classic non-glitter monster and non-holographic card.
Keep every edge of the complete rounded lavender border, equal transparent margins, no exterior shadow, halo or visible canvas-edge pixels. This is a precise local color correction, not a new card design.
